features: Intelligently identifies people, products, animals, cars, and objects
Handles complex edges like hair, fur, and fine details
Creates clean, transparent cutouts (PNG) or replaces with any color

faq.title: AI Image Background Remover FAQs
faq.description: Common questions about our AI Image Background Remover.

q1.question: What image formats are supported?
q1.answer: We support JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC. For best results, use high-quality images.

q2.question: Will my images have a watermark?
q2.answer: No. All downloads are clean and watermark-free.

q3.question: How accurate is the AI?
q3.answer: Our AI excels at hair, fur, and complex edges. For very intricate cases, use the simple refine tools to perfect the result.

q4.question: Can I remove backgrounds from multiple images?
q4.answer: Yes – batch processing lets you upload and remove backgrounds from several images at once.

q5.question: Is my data safe?
q5.answer: Yes. Uploaded images are processed securely and automatically deleted after processing. We never use your images for training.

q6.question: Can I change the background color?
q6.answer: Yes – download with transparent background or choose white/solid color background.

q7.question: What kinds of images work best?
q7.answer: Images with a clear main subject (person, product, object, animal) against a contrasting or cluttered background yield the best automatic results. Portraits, product shots, and logos perform exceptionally well.

q8.question: Can I refine or edit the result after AI removal?
q8.answer: Yes – simple brush tools let you manually restore any accidentally removed parts or erase remaining background spots for pixel-perfect control.
